notes.title: More facial expression controls
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of our game. We have added some new features in this update to make you more enjoyable in the game!

1. The main scene has added a facial expression selection function, and now you can freely choose your partner's facial expression.
2. The volume control function has been added, and now you can control the volume of the music of the concert and the ambient sound in the rain scene. 
3. Fixed bugs reported by players.
 
Thank you for your support and feedback, we will continue to update and optimize the game content to bring you a better gaming experience! Don't forget to share this update with your Steam friends!
